items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: after David got with us, we just added that first time.

ctx.x: Two beats, two measure. Yeah, yeah. You wouldn't, would you beat your foot as you played? Yeah. Would you only beat two beats, two measure rather than four?
No, yeah. At the beginning we started but after that we added, we said after David got with us, we just added that first time. Four beats, two measure. Four beats.
